en: This is an old postcard featuring handwritten text on both the left and right sides. The word 'BREVKORT' (meaning 'postcard' in Norwegian) is printed at the top, along with 'CARTE POSTALE' and 'POST CARD.' There is a green 5-øre stamp in the upper right corner, and a postmark dated 3-10-1906 with the location 'KRISTIANIA' visible. The address is written in cursive, and the left side contains a message written vertically. The sender's and recipient's details are present.
